changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.21[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: release group hints for the personal ranker[/COLOR]
-The group that made a release (the name after the last hyphen: ...HEVC-FLUX is FLUX) now counts in the personal ranker, from the very first search.
-Groups rated by TRaSH Guides get a small hint: tier 1 more than tier 2, tier 2 more than tier 3, and groups on the low-quality list a small push down. The tier follows the kind of release: WEB, Blu-ray, UHD Blu-ray or REMUX.
-It is a hint, never a filter: it is worth less than HDR or Atmos and never jumps quality. Groups that are not on the lists, such as most Spanish releases, are not pushed down. The hint fades as the ranker learns what you actually play.
-Show personal ranker stats lists the release groups it has seen.
-Settings > Source Options > Personalized ranker (For You) > Release group hints (TRaSH Guides), on by default. Release group lists from TRaSH Guides (MIT licence).
[COLOR fffdb515]Personal ranker: smarter learning[/COLOR]
-Auto-Play: sources tried before the one that played are no longer counted as passed over. They only count against their scraper and debrid service.
-A source counts as a good choice when you really watch it. If you stop it within two minutes and pick another source of the same title within 15 minutes, the first one counts as a failure.
-Older choices fade: Settings > Source Options > Personalized ranker (For You) > Forget older choices after: Never, 30 days, 90 days (default), 180 days or 1 year. What you have learned so far is kept and starts fading from today.
[COLOR fffdb515]New: Catalog precache in System status[/COLOR]
-System status has a new Catalog precache section: fast lists, rest of menu and the weekly platforms and networks rotation, with how many lists are ready, when they ran and which ones did not come back.
-Run now starts a precache in the background. The last result is kept when Kodi restarts.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Trakt Manager: Mark as watched and Mark as unwatched failed for every show, season and episode opened from the luc_kodi context panel. It now goes by what the menu was opened on, so it works the same from the context panel, Kodi's context menu and widgets.
-Mark as watched for a single episode now tries again by its TheTVDB id when Trakt does not find the show by its IMDb id.
